top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Tour o' the Borders. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 75 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Tour o' the Borders' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
52ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Tour o' the Borders, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Tour o' the Borders. Train it until it feels boring.
75 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Tour o' the Borders. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,937ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Tour o' the Borders' 75 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Tour o' the Borders. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Tour o' the Borders rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 75 miles of mixed terrain in Peebles, Scottish Borders, Scotland.
